title: larix gmelinii var. koreana
intro: Larix gmelinii var. koreana, commonly known as Korean Larch, is a deciduous coniferous tree species native to East Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Korean Larch include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve immune function, and protect against oxidative stress, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These compounds have been shown to have anti-inflammatory, anti-hypertensive, and anti-microbial properties, making Korean Larch a potentially valuable resource for traditional medicine and pharmacological research.
